---
description: .NET and C# engineering rules.
applyTo: "**/*.cs,**/*.fs,**/*.vb,**/*.csproj,**/*.fsproj,**/*.vbproj,**/*.sln"
---
# .NET

- Detect target frameworks, solution/project boundaries, nullable settings, analyzers, test framework, and ASP.NET usage.
- Preserve async/cancellation flows and dependency-injection conventions.
- Use project/solution commands and do not change target frameworks casually.
